name: Babes
overview: Scripture reveals that babes symbolize purity, humility, and the foundational praise of God, as seen in Psalms 8:2 where strength is ordained from their mouths against enemies. Jesus highlights that divine truths are revealed to babes rather than the wise, emphasizing their guileless nature (Matthew 11:25). Furthermore, He instructs believers to become like little children—humble and dependent—to enter and be great in the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 18:2-5), underscoring babes as a powerful figure of weak yet sincere Christians and true discipleship.
